EDI Segment Definitions:
HDR = Header (Student ID, Type, **, Issue Date, End Date)
ST = Term (Year, Semester, Start Date, End Date)
ELMT = Element (Course Code, **, Course Name, Grade, Quality Points, Credits)
STC = Term Summary (Count, Credits, Quality Points, GPA)
BAT = Batch/Term Summary (Year, Term Count, Total Credits, Total Quality Pts, GPA)
TRR = Transcript Record Summary (Earned Credits, Attempted Credits, Cumulative GPA, Date)
